searchText: I'm a bit confused which EIPs go into fusaka-devnet-0. https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/fusaka-devnet-0 says EIP-7883, while https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7607 has EIP-7823 & EIP-7892 CFI'ed. I thought we agreed to CFI & include into devnet-0 all 3 of them (7883, 7823, 7892). I have adjusted the notes with 7892. As far as I recall, we only decided to include 7883 modexp gas cost increase in devnet 0 and decided against 7823 for now, as said that we would include that in devnet-1, due to extra difficulty in implementation. So devnet 0 target: 7594 7823 7883 7892 ~~Devnet 1 target: all of devnet 0 + 7823~~ <@412614104222531604> btw, the doc says "devnet-7" in the EIP List fixed thanks We have draft PRs of both modexp EIPs in besu, don't think 7823 upper bounds is more complicated than gas increase, maybe even easier, in besu at least. I'm happy to also add 7823 to devnet-0 spec, if all ELs are on board tbh. <@360491619402776577> <@519796549279023105> Lets add it, move a bit faster Axxelerate yup, we are for including all modexp related changes in devnet 0 "7Set upper bounds for MODEXP"? edited notes, now this is the goal for next monday ~~it's clear to me that the benefits of EIP-7892 were overestimated and nuances have not been thoroughly discussed. there are two active ongoing threads rn <#1360267444911865876> & <#1360292816235925605>. if we do not manage to reach some form of consensus on 7892 and discuss the implications of it for the CLs, i suggest taking it out of devnet 0~~ resolved I think we need to get on an agreement today. Hopefully now everyone is the same page regarding BPO topic! Please let me know if you have a client image/branch that’s ready with all the EIP implementation and ready to be tested with other clients! If we add 7892 to devnet 0, we most likely need another consensus spec release since https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4277 is not included in v1.5.0 <@592004585506340885> Looks like https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4316 v1.6.0-alpha.0 is scheduled to be released tomorrow. I presume this will be the version we are targeting for devnet 0. If so, we can update the target version in https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/fusaka-devnet-0 updated Yup working on it now. Will try to have it out tonight.

excerpts.author: yperbasis
excerpts.content: I'm a bit confused which EIPs go into fusaka-devnet-0. https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/fusaka-devnet-0 says EIP-7883, while https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7607 has EIP-7823 & EIP-7892 CFI'ed. I thought we agreed to CFI & include into devnet-0 all 3 of them (7883, 7823, 7892).

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content:
I have adjusted the notes with 7892. As far as I recall, we only decided to include 7883 modexp gas cost increase in devnet 0 and decided against 7823 for now, as said that we would include that in devnet-1, due to extra difficulty in implementation. 

So 
devnet 0 target:
7594
7823
7883
7892

~~Devnet 1 target: 
all of devnet 0 
+ 7823~~
